Forecast Discussion

NWS Detroit/Pontiac · 549 AM EDT Tue Oct 27 2026

- Dry today with cooler temperatures compared to recent days. 

- Mild temperatures return through the rest of the week highlighted 
by highs around 70 Wednesday and in the lower to mid 70s Thursday. 

- There is a chance of showers Thursday afternoon and Thursday night.

- Dry and continued mild Friday.

&&

.AVIATION...

We remain north of a stalled front with surface high pressure 
centered over Ontario spread across the Great Lakes. This will lead 
to easterly flow through the period below 10 knots. There will be 
plenty of cloud around, mainly mid and high cloud as moisture works 
up and over the stalled front. Though clouds will mostly be at or 
above 10kft, there will be a period early this afternoon where 
soundings suggest we could generate some clouds around 4-6kft for a 
few hours. Another period of clouds under 10kft will be possible 
tonight. 

D21/DTW Convection... Thunderstorms are not forecast through the TAF 
period.

.DTW THRESHOLD PROBABILITIES...

 * Low for cigs at or below 5000 ft through tonight.
